Man Arrested for Decades-Long Luxury Hotel Fraud Across India

A 69-year-old man has been arrested in Odisha for allegedly defrauding hundreds of luxury hotels across India over 36 years. He is accused of staying at approximately 300 hotels, using false identities, and leaving without paying bills, with one instance involving over Rs 63,000 and a stolen laptop. The man reportedly drew inspiration from the criminal Charles Sobhraj.
